item.description:
## Fixed
- Browse Nexus shows SMAPI as **Installed** (or **Update** when a newer one is out). SMAPI lives next to the game rather than in the Mods folder, so it wasn't recognized. - Requirements no longer says "Nothing missing" while it's still looking up your mods' requirements. - The profile panel no longer re-reads all your save files each time it redraws.
